1.name: Cluster 1: Advanced Infrastructure & Emerging Lifestyle/NCD Risk
1.description: High institutional delivery (>96%), strong sanitation and literacy, but elevated adult obesity (35.5%) and diabetes/hypertension risks.

2.name: Cluster 2: Intermediate / Progressing Health Profile
2.description: Highest childhood routine immunization (83.3%), strong delivery coverage, but persistent child and maternal anaemia (>60%).

3.name: Cluster 3: High Foundational Healthcare Vulnerability
3.description: Severe primary care deficits: 4+ ANC visits under 41%, child stunting at 40.5%, early marriage (30%), and low sanitation (59.5%).

4.name: Cluster 4: Distinct Hill & Northeastern Health Geography
4.description: High social capital and sanitation (>84%), but severe institutional delivery gaps (69%), extreme out-of-pocket delivery costs, and high substance use.
